task_metadata.title: CHRONOS-X Temporal Eligibility & False Transient Promotion Safety Remediation

baseline_policy.description: Project-level safety baseline rule for secular variability comparisons. Same-visit metadata overrides misleading timestamp differences.

pair_discovery.before: min_time_diff_days=0.001 (86.4s) allowed intra-visit dithers (2.15-6.47 min) to be tagged as temporal observation pairs.
pair_discovery.after: min_time_diff_days=1.0 day operational minimum; intra-visit dithers are explicitly tagged temporal_eligibility='FALSE' and is_dither=True.

candidate_classification.before: Residual significance > 5.0 sigma on dither without Gaia match was automatically promoted to NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE.
candidate_classification.after: Promotion to NEW_TRANSIENT_OR_ASTEROID_CANDIDATE strictly requires temporal_eligibility='TRUE'. Dithers or unverified pairs receive ANOMALOUS_RESIDUAL_REQUIRES_REVIEW.

missing_metadata.before: Files with missing MJD or coordinates were silently dropped from pairing without audit records.
missing_metadata.after: Missing metadata produces structured UNVERIFIABLE candidate pairs preserving explicit missing_evidence provenance.

evidence_tier_separation.before: Evidence tiers were conflated with temporal separation.
evidence_tier_separation.after: E0-E4 completeness is completely orthogonal to temporal eligibility. Intra-visit dithers achieve full E4 completeness while remaining temporal_eligibility='FALSE'.

changed_files.description: Implemented temporal eligibility engine, 10 scientific checks, E0-E4 evidence tier separation, and dataset availability function.
Package init re-exporting differencer, quality masks, and temporal eligibility contracts.
Safeguarded reproject import and re-exported temporal eligibility functions.
Added ALLOWED_TEMPORAL_ELIGIBILITY_STATUSES and temporal_eligibility field to CandidateRecord dataclass with full serialization.
Integrated temporal eligibility safety gate into evaluate_source and _classify, preventing false transient promotions.
Updated find_temporal_pairs to evaluate temporal eligibility, preserve dither registration utility, and retain UNVERIFIABLE pairs.
17 comprehensive unit and regression tests covering all 12 mandatory requirements.

remaining_limitations: No multi-epoch Level-2 FITS files exist locally in data/spherex (all local overlapping pairs are intra-visit dithers).
Dataset-level temporal availability for local data remains correctly reported as TEMPORAL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE.
Real multi-epoch transient discovery requires retrieval of remote IRSA archive observation assets (Weeks 31-32).
